name: Thai Life Insurance Public Company Limited
summary: Thai Life Insurance Public Company Limited provides life insurance products in Thailand. It operates in two segments, Agent Channel and Partnership and Other Channels. The company offers life and saving products, including whole life, endowment, annuity, term life, unit link, and universal life; other products, such as personal accident and yearly renewable term, as well as credit life; and individual and group products comprising protection, savings, investment, and legacy-planning. It sells its products through commercial banks, government banks and organizations, leasing and hire-purchase, consumer finance partners, direct marketing, group employee benefits, and digital platforms.
